chapter.verse: Tu-in upna i cih pen lamet thute ah sunglam kimuanna hi a, muhloh nate theihcianna hi.
A hang pen tanglai pupite in tua upna tawh pahtakna na ngah uh hi.
Tu-a i muhte, muhtheih nate tawh a kibawl hilo-in a om vannuai Pasian' kammal tawh a kipiangsak ahihlam upna tawh i theih ahi hi.

Abel in Cain' biakpiakna sangin a santaakzaw khat upna tawh luui a, ama' biakpiak vante Pasian in sang ahih manin tua tawh midik cih pahtakna ngah hi. Tua hi a, Abel si khin ahih hangin a upna tungtawnin thu a pulak lai ahi hi.
Enoch kilato a, upna tawh sihna a tuakkha lo ahi hi. Pasian in lato ahih manin amah kimu nawnlo hi. A hang pen Enoch in amah a kilaktoh ma-in Pasian lungkimsak cih ciaptehna hoih ngah hi.
Tua hi a, upna lo tawh Pasian kilungkimsak theilo hi. A hang pen Pasian' kiang a zuan mi in Pasian om cih thu leh amah a zong mite pahtakman pia cih thu a up kul ahih man hi.

Noah in a kimu nailo thute tawh kisai Pasian' hilhphawnna a ngah ciangin zahtakna tawh thupilakin a innkuanpihte a hotkhiat nadingin upna tawh tembaw khat lam hi. Tua tungtawnin leitung a mawhna kilangsak a, amah ahihleh upna tunga kinga diktatna thupha a luahpa suak hi.
Abraham in gamh bangin ama' luah ding mun khat ah a kuankhia dingin sapkhiat a ngah ciangin upna tawh na mang hi. Koi ah pai ding cih thei lo pi mahin amah kuankhia hi.
Kamciamna gam ah mundang gamdang a beel pemta bangin upna tawh va kiphual a, kamciam a sankhoppih Isaac leh Jacob tawh buk sungah teeng uh hi.
A hang pen Abraham in Pasian a geelpa leh a lampa ahihna mun, khuambul a nei khuapi lamenin om hi.
Sarah zong a ciing hinapi kamciam a piapa muanhuai hi ci-in pom ahih manin khanhoih hun a khen khit nangawnin upna tawh naupaai theihna thuphapi ngah hi.
Tua hi a, misi a bang phial mi khat sungpanin vantung aksi a tampite zah leh tuipi piaudung-a sehnel mal simzawhlohte zah suanlekhak piang hi.

Hih mite khempeuh amau' tunga kamciam a kipiate a gah mukha lo uh ahih hangin tuate a gamlapi pan gal-et khol uhin dawntuah khol uh a, hih leitung ah khualmi pemta ahihna uh kithei kawmin upna tawh a si uh ahi hi.
A hang pen tua bang thu a gen uh ciangin amau' ading tawntung gam khat a zong uh ahihlam a kilangsak uh ahi hi.
A paikhiatsan uh gam phawkkik uh hileh ciahkik theih nading hunpha ngah mahmah ding uh hi.
Tu-in ahihleh gam a hoihzaw khat, vantung tawh kisai khat, a lunggulh uh hizaw hi. Tua hangin Pasian zong amaute' Pasian a kicih ding maizum lo a, amaute' ading khuapi khat na bawlkholhsak hi.
Abraham in amah a kizia-et ciangin biakpiak nadingin upna tawh Isaac luui hi. Kamciam a ngah mipa, ama' tapa neihsun mah biakpiakna-in a luui hong suak hi.
A taktak, Pasian in ama' kiangah, “Isaac tungtawnin nangma' suanlekhak cih min kilo ding hi,” a cih ahi hi.
Misite' lakpan Isaac a thokiksak thei Pasian ci-in Abraham in sehin pom ahih manin, genteh kamin gen lehang, a tapa a ngahkik ahi hi.
Isaac in zong mailam thu tawh kisai-in upna tawh Jacob leh Esau thupha pia hi.
Jacob a sih ding ciangin a ciangkhut bul tungah kingamin Pasian a biak kawmin Joseph' tate, upna tawh khatta-in thupha pia hi.
Joseph a nuntak a bei ding ciangin Israel mite' paikhiat ding vai upna tawh pulak a, ama' guhte bangci hih ding cih vaikhak hi.
Moses a suah ciangin ama' nulehpa in naungek a mel hoih cih a muh uh ciangin kumpipa' thupiakna kihta lo-in upna tawh kha thum sung naungek selcip uh hi.
Moses a gol ciangin Pharaoh' tanu ii tapa a kicih ding ut nawnlo-in upna tawh nolh hi.
Mawhna sunga sauvei a kimanglo nopsaknate ngah ding sangin Pasian' mite tawh simmawh thuakkhop ding teelzaw hi.
A ngah ding pahtakman mitsuan ahih manin Egypt hauhnate sangin Khris' hangin simmawh thuakna mah hauhna a lianzaw-in ngaihsun hi.
Muhtheihloh Pasian a mukha dan khatin thuakzawhna nei a, kumpipa' heh ding lau lo-in upna tawh Egypt nusiatsan hi.
Tacilte a susiapa in amaute a sukkhak loh nadingin Moses in upna tawh Paisan Pawi bawlin sisan theh hi.
Israel mite in lei keu tunga lampai bang khatin upna tawh San Tuipi kantan uh a, amau' hih bangin Egypt mite in a sawm uh ciangin tui sungah tummang uh hi.
Jericho khuapi kulhte pen upna tawh ni sagih a kikimvel khit ciangin a cim ahi hi.
Numei kizuak Rahab in upna tawh thukante thunuam tawh na sang ahih manin thumanglo mite tawh sikhawm lo hi.
Tua hi a, bang hong genbeh lai ding ka hi hiam? Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David leh Samuel-a kipan kamsangte' thu teng a cingin kong gen man nawnkei ding hi.
Hih mite pen upna tawh kumpigamte simin a zote, thumaan thutang a zatpihte, kamciamna gah a mukhate, humpi kam a humte,
meikuang a lianpipi a sumitte, namsau muk pan a suaktate, zawngkhalna sungah thadimna a ngahte, galmai ah mithahat a suakte leh gamdang galkapte a zogawpte ahi uh hi.
Thawhkikna hangin numeite in a misite uh ngahkik uh hi. Kimkhatte ahihleh nuntakna a hoihzaw khat ah a thawhkik theih nadingun khahkhiatna nolhin bawlsiat thuakzaw uh hi.
Zahpihna leh satna banah kolbulh khaukhih leh thongkiatna nangawn a thuak zong om uh hi.
Suang tawh a kidenglum, sing-at tawh phel nih a kisuah, namsau tawh tualthah a thuak, cih bang zong om uh hi. Tuuvun keelvun silhin kikawileh uh a, bangmah nei lo-in gimna leh simmawhna thuak uh hi.
(Leitung pen amau' ading a kilawm zolo ahi hi.) Amaute gamgawtak lak, mualtung teng leh kuahawm kenkawm lak khawng ah kipumleh kawikawi uh hi.
Hih mite khempeuh, a upna uh tungtawnin pahtak-huai ahih hangin amau' tunga kipia kamciamte a gah mukha lo uh hi.
A hang pen ei' kihel lohin amau kia a cingtaak a suah theih loh nadingin Pasian in eite' ading a hoihzaw khat hong vaihawmsak ahi hi.
